old: Refutation of a widely repeated number: '1 billion tokens a month on Mistral's free tier' belongs to the Experiment plan that Mistral retired, and no current Mistral page states it. The 'USD 10 a month in API credits' line was on the pricing page in early October 2026 according to a change tracker; it is absent today and absent from the 2026-09-01 capture, so the exact date it left is unverified and the current state is that no figure is published. Identity: third-party signup guides report a one-time SMS verification and no card, and no Mistral page states a phone step; recorded as any-phone, reported rather than documented. Data on Free mode may be used for training unless opted out, which is a technical reliability fact a batch job should account for.
new: Refutation of widely repeated figures: the monthly token and per-second request figures that third-party guides print for Mistral's free API tier are attributed to the Experiment plan, whose help article is no longer served, and no current Mistral docs, help or pricing page prints a Free mode figure; the docs defer to the Limits page behind sign-in. The monthly API credit line of the Free card on mistral.ai/pricing, present in archive captures of 2026-09-01 and 2026-10-05, is absent from the live page on 2026-10-31. Identity: the Experiment plan help article, as archived on 2026-05-18, required a verified phone number, one per plan, and no credit card; the current registration form asks for an email and a password, with no phone field. Free mode inputs and outputs may be used for model training unless the Anonymous improvement data toggle under Privacy in the Admin panel is disabled.

No figure appears on any public Mistral page: the docs point at admin.mistral.ai/plateforme/limits, which is behind a login. The 'USD 10 /mo in API credits' line that third parties still quote is no longer on mistral.ai/pricing, and a 2026-09-01 archive capture does not carry it either.
